text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the existing parking prohibition on the west side of Torresdale Avenue be rescinded and replaced with maximum three-hour parking between a point 26 metres south of Steeles Avenue West and a point 61 metres south of Steeles Avenue West. The proposed amendments will address residents' concerns regarding the lack of on-street parking. The maximum three-hour parking will provide approximately 11 parking spaces on-street.

The North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the parking prohibition in effect at all times on the west side of Torresdale Avenue, between a point 26 metres south of Steeles Avenue West and a point 61 metres south of Steeles Avenue West. 2. Prohibited parking at all times on the west side of Torresdale Avenue, between a point 87 metres south of Steeles Avenue West and a point 36 metres further south.
